summary: Comprehensive frontend testing completed for MedMatch. All major UI components, user flows, and integrations verified. 27/28 features tested successfully. Minor issues found: Onboarding tour modal persists despite localStorage setting, some translation keys showing raw keys instead of translated text.

ui_bugs.issue: Onboarding modal appears on every login despite localStorage 'medmatch-tour-completed' being set to 'true'. Modal buttons show raw translation keys like 'common.back' and 'common.next' instead of translated text.
Some translation keys showing raw keys: 'notifications.historyTitle', 'notifications.historyDesc'

integration_issues.issue: Dropbox and OneDrive show 'Coming soon' in UI despite backend APIs being configured. CloudStorageUpload.jsx has hardcoded configured: false for these providers
